name: nocturna
description: Nocturna — Chi dorme non sopravvive. Social deduction webapp.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nocturna/shared && npm run build -w @nocturna/server && npm run build -w @nocturna/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c crimson,amber "npm run dev -w @nocturna/server" "npm run dev -w @nocturna/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @nocturna/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nocturna/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nocturna/server && npm run typecheck -w @nocturna/client
scripts.dist:host:prepare: npm run build && npm run prepare:host && npm --prefix host install
scripts.dist:host: npm run dist:host:prepare && npm --prefix host run dist
scripts.dist:host:linux: npm run dist:host:prepare && npm --prefix host run dist:linux
scripts.dist:host:win: npm run dist:host:prepare && npm --prefix host run dist:win
scripts.dist:host:mac: npm run dist:host:prepare && npm --prefix host run dist:mac
scripts.dist:host:all: npm run dist:host:prepare && npm --prefix host run dist:all
